name: Carousel
description: A swipeable carousel on the brand's paper, one PNG per slide: a cover, two to six numbered points and a closing call to action. A point left empty drops its slide, and the slides are counted as they show.

eyebrow.label: Eyebrow
eyebrow.description: A short label in the dark pill, e.g. WHY IT MATTERS. Leave empty for none.

headline.label: Headline
headline.description: The big statement. Use | to break the line, e.g. 5 SIGNS|YOUR AGENT|NEEDS A|HARNESS

headline_accent.label: Accent words
headline_accent.description: Words of the headline shown in the brand colour, exactly as they appear in it. Leave empty for none.

subline.label: Supporting line
subline.description: One or two sentences on the cover. Leave empty for none.

point_1_body.label: Point 1 text
point_1_body.description: A sentence or two on slide 2. Leave empty for none.

point_2_body.label: Point 2 text
point_2_body.description: A sentence or two on slide 3. Leave empty for none.

point_3_title.label: Point 3 heading
point_3_title.description: The heading of slide 4. Leave empty and the slide is left out.

point_3_body.label: Point 3 text
point_3_body.description: A sentence or two on slide 4. Leave empty for none.

point_4_title.label: Point 4 heading
point_4_title.description: The heading of slide 5. Leave empty and the slide is left out.

point_4_body.label: Point 4 text
point_4_body.description: A sentence or two on slide 5. Leave empty for none.

point_5_title.label: Point 5 heading
point_5_title.description: The heading of slide 6. Leave empty and the slide is left out.

point_5_body.label: Point 5 text
point_5_body.description: A sentence or two on slide 6. Leave empty for none.

point_6_title.label: Point 6 heading
point_6_title.description: The heading of slide 7. Leave empty and the slide is left out.

point_6_body.label: Point 6 text
point_6_body.description: A sentence or two on slide 7. Leave empty for none.

closing_title.label: Closing heading
closing_title.description: The last slide's statement, e.g. Build the harness first.

closing_body.label: Closing text
closing_body.description: A sentence or two on the last slide. Leave empty for none.

cta.label: Call to action
cta.description: The button on the last slide, e.g. Follow for more. Leave empty for none.

swipe_hint.label: Swipe hint
swipe_hint.description: The footer of every other slide, e.g. Swipe. Leave empty for none.

handle.label: Handle
handle.description: The account handle shown top right, e.g. @yourbrand. Leave empty for none.

sample_data.headline: 4 SIGNS|YOUR AGENT|NEEDS A|HARNESS
sample_data.subline: The model is rarely the problem. Here is what goes wrong around it, and what to do instead.
sample_data.point_1_title: It forgets what it just did
sample_data.point_1_body: Without memory it has no state between steps, so every turn starts from zero.
sample_data.point_2_body: Forty tools in the prompt means forty chances to choose badly. Give it the few it needs.
sample_data.point_3_title: It never knows when to stop
sample_data.point_3_body: A loop without a goal check runs until the budget does. Define done before you start.
sample_data.point_4_title: Nobody can see why it failed
sample_data.point_4_body: Log every step, tool call and result. You cannot fix what you cannot read.
sample_data.closing_body: The model you have is good enough. The system around it decides the result.

probe.what: the brand stripe along the top edge
